<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 276.0666. In positive‑mode ESI this is typically the [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral mass of ≈ 275.0593 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed 13C isotopic pattern (≈ 16 % M+1, consistent with ~14 carbons) is C₁₄H₁₂O₆ (exact monoisotopic mass 276.0634 Da, within a few mDa of the measured value).</thought>
<final_answer>C14H12O6</final_answer>
